text_sections.label: Special Digivolution Condition
text_sections.text: [DNA Digivolution] Yellow/black Lv.6 + green/purple Lv.6: Cost 0 Digivolve unsuspended with the 2 specified Digimon stacked on top of each other.

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text:
＜Partition (yellow/black Lv.6 & green/purple Lv.6)＞ (When this Digimon with each of the specified digivolution cards would leave the battle area other than by your effects or a battle, you may play 1 each of the specified cards without paying the costs.)
[When Digivolving] If DNA digivolving, you may place up to 2 level 6 cards from your trash as this Digimon's bottom digivolution cards. Then, for each of this Digimon's level 6 digivolution cards, return 1 of your opponent's Digimon to the bottom of the deck.
[Your Turn] This Digimon with 4 or more level 6 digivolution cards gains ＜Security A. +3＞ and ＜Piercing＞.

qa.question: When DNA digivolving into this card, can I DNA digivolve using a level 6 yellow Digimon and a level 6 black Digimon, or using a level 6 green Digimon and a level 6 purple Digimon?

qa.answer:
No, you can't.
This card's effect can only play a combination of 1 level 6 yellow or black Digimon and 1 level 6 green or purple Digimon.
qa.question: Can I use this card's effect to play a level 6 yellow Digimon and a level 6 black Digimon or a level 6 green Digimon and a level 6 purple Digimon from digivolution cards?

qa.answer:
Yes, you can process it.
Even if this Digimon didn't DNA digivolve, this card's [When Digivolving] effect will return 1 of your opponent's Digimon to the bottom of the deck for each of this card's level 6 digivolution cards.
